correctness.rationale: The counting lower bound gives the claimed target. For orders 8 and 10, an exhaustive normalized complement generator covers every simple 5-regular graph up to relabeling; every generated completion has a certified spanning subgraph satisfying the Shan--Zhong degree-class criterion, and the checker reconstructs and directly verifies the resulting total labeling. The explicit K6 labeling is also replayed. The proof is finite for n<=10 and makes no inference beyond that range.
